title: Emotional Well-Being Check
description: A Cozy well-being check-in. Reflect on your overall emotional health and well-being.
disclaimer: This Cozy well-being check-in is for personal reflection. It is not a diagnosis or a validated clinical screening tool. The result describes only your answers to these five questions. If you are concerned about your well-being, speak with a qualified professional. If you feel unsafe or need urgent help, contact local emergency services or use the app's crisis support resources.

scoring_rules.recommendation: These descriptive result bands are for personal reflection and do not measure clinical severity.

bands.label: More support may help
bands.recommendation: Your answers suggest fewer experiences that support emotional well-being. Consider activities that help you feel connected, grounded and supported. If you are concerned, consider speaking with a qualified professional.

bands.label: Building well-being
bands.recommendation: Your answers suggest some experiences that support emotional well-being, with room to build on them. Consider activities that help you feel connected, grounded and supported.

bands.label: Good well-being
bands.recommendation: Your answers suggest regular experiences that support emotional well-being. Keep practising what helps you.

bands.label: Strong well-being
bands.recommendation: Your answers suggest frequent experiences that support emotional well-being. Continue the habits and connections that help you.

questions.question: Over the past two weeks, how often have you felt happy and content?
How often do you feel that your life has a sense of purpose?
How often do you feel connected to others?
How often do you feel that you are able to manage your emotions effectively?
How often do you feel optimistic about your future?
